key_derivation: The rule is the literal linker flag at Makefile.am:64: only symbols matching the regex ^j[qv]_ are exported, and the ABI is pinned by -version-info 1:4:0 on the same line. The public surface is therefore the jq_*/jv_* declarations in the two headers that Makefile.am:71 installs — src/jq.h (jq_init, jq_compile, jq_compile_args, jq_start, jq_next, jq_teardown, the jq_set_*/jq_get_* callback and attribute pairs, the jq_util_input_* family, jq_set_colors, ...) and src/jv.h. The boundary is sharp and checkable: anything declared only in src/jv_private.h or in a non-installed header is internal even
